Hello! I'm a Behavioral Scientist with a PhD in Personality Psychology specializing in leveraging AI and machine learning to uncover psychological patterns and cultural nuances in human behavior. I develop culturally sensitive models that minimize bias, enabling me to discern both universal and culture-specific dynamics in how people think, feel, and act. By integrating user-centered research with advanced analytical techniques, I transform these insights into actionable business strategies that drive effective outcomes.
